purpose: Give a personal reason with an emotional or defensive tone.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Plain clause + もの / もん; often んだもの
I do not want to walk today. My feet hurt, you see.
Of course I am happy. I have wanted it for ages.
Let us go home early. We have an exam tomorrow, after all.
formation: Plain clause + もの / もん; often んだもの
restrictions: Often sentence-final; もん is especially informal.
mistake: Avoid in formal explanations or respectful apologies.
